records.title: S-DAG: A Subject-Based Directed Acyclic Graph for Multi-Agent Heterogeneous Reasoning
records.reason: S-DAG structures multi-agent heterogeneous reasoning as a subject-based directed acyclic graph and evaluates reasoning quality. It may reduce redundant agent collaboration, but the full text provides no clear inference cost or latency claim.

records.title: SG-UniBuc-NLP at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Multi-Head RoBERTa with Chunking for Long-Context Evasion Detection
records.reason: SG-UniBuc-NLP uses chunked RoBERTa for long-context evasion detection. Its contribution is a SemEval task system and classification score, not general long-context inference optimization.

records.title: DART: Mitigating Harm Drift in Difference-Aware LLMs via Distill-Audit-Repair Training
records.reason: DART is a Distill-Audit-Repair training workflow for harm drift in difference-aware LLMs. Its evaluations concern safety behavior rather than inference compute or system efficiency.

records.title: CuMA: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Cultural Values via Demographic-Aware Mixture of Adapters
records.reason: CuMA aligns LLMs with sparse cultural values using demographic-aware adapter mixtures. The work is training/alignment and does not report inference-efficiency benefits.

records.title: Large Language Models for Compiler Optimization
records.reason: Large Language Models for Compiler Optimization studies LLMs as compiler optimization agents; it does not optimize the LLM inference runtime itself.
